items.rationale: FDA Sept 2013 per-sample total As, inorganic As, DMA and MMA (ppb) for ~480 rice samples (dry weight) and ~840 rice-containing products, including infant cereal and infant formula; summary tables are per serving only.

locators.location: Full Analytical Results - Rice and Rice Products, pp. 29-66

items.rationale: Per-product ICP-MS concentrations (Al, Mn, Cu, Se, Rb, Ba) for 22 protein powders, with As, Cd, Hg and Pb below detection in every product.
Exposure assessment built on pooled means of published brown-vs-white rice studies; no new measurements. Table 4 unit label (µg/kg) is inconsistent with the magnitudes (mg/kg).
Pot experiment on six rice varieties with Cd-spiked soil and foliar Si; brown-rice Cd values are only in Fig. 3, the text gives percentage changes with and without Si, which are recorded as controls.
WHO GEMS/Food individual and aggregated results for every food: Pb, Cd, Hg, Al, Sn, Ni and Cr from the June 2026 export and every arsenic species from the May 2026 per-region exports.
Clinical pilot trial of purified rice endosperm protein (REP) powder; Table 1 prints the Cd content of the REP supplement (5 batches). The remaining results concern patient outcomes.
